    Naming your Chanter

    The Chanter is Aion 2's hybrid support. It fights with a staff and buffs the party with mantras and chants while still holding its own in melee. Chanter names suit a monk-like, rhythmic feel: syllables that roll off the tongue, like Canto, Hanrei, Loryn or Sorantu.

    The generator gives Chanters roots like Ca-, Han-, Lo-, Ry- and endings like -ant, -yr, -ren. The compound tone turns out names like Dawnhymn, Stormchant and Ashmantra, which is perfect if you want people to know you're the one keeping the buffs up.

    Quick tips

    • Musical words (hymn, chant, verse, echo) are a natural fit.
    • Repeating sounds (Lolan, Sesaren) give a name a chant-like rhythm.
    • Chanters are often the shot-caller: pick something short enough to say in voice chat.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is a good Chanter name?

    Rhythmic, monk-like names such as Canto, Loryn, Hanrei or Dawnhymn suit the class. Use the generator above for more.

    What role does the Chanter play in Aion 2?

    The Chanter is a support and melee hybrid that empowers allies while still fighting up close, so its names lean toward chant and mantra themes.

    How do I use the Chanter name generator?

    The class is already set to Chanter. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, pick a gender and tone, then hit Generate. Click any name to copy it, or ☆ to save it to your shortlist.
